question.content:
The Venus flytrap is a carnivorous plant found in wetlands along the east coast of the United States. The soil of the Venus flytrap’s habitat tends to be acidic and low in nutrients. Although the Venus flytrap does photosynthesize, it also uses sticky leaf traps to catch and digest ants, spiders, beetles, and other crawling arthropods to obtain additional nutrients.  

[[☃ image 1]]

**Which of the following describes a biotic factor in the Venus flytrap’s habitat?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

[[☃ explanation 1]]

choices.clue: Soil acidity is a non-living part of the environment. So, it is an *abiotic factor*, not a biotic factor.
Spiders are living organisms. So, they are biotic factors.
Soil nutrients are non-living parts of the environment. So, they are *abiotic factors*, not biotic factors.
Sunlight is a non-living part of the environment. So, it is an *abiotic factor*, not a biotic factor.
